skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic concepts, methods, and skills for data analysis using advanced data mining techniques to extract knowledge from large datasets.
Use data mining techniques to solve problems in economics and business, and select appropriate techniques for data analysis.
Apply data preprocessing techniques such as cleaning, integration, reduction, and transformation.
Use pattern recognition techniques to discover knowledge from data.
Apply clustering algorithms to group data into meaningful clusters.
Use machine learning algorithms for classification and regression tasks.
Interpret analysis results to support decision-making in economic and business contexts.
Work collaboratively in a team and take responsibility for individual contributions.
Use Python for data analysis and machine learning tasks.
Use R for data analysis and visualization.
Use SQL for database management and data querying.
Use Business Intelligence tools for data analysis and visualization.
Analyze and evaluate data to make informed decisions.
